# Invoices still use the old date handling the team marked as replaced

src/invoice.js writes its date with legacyFormat from lib/legacy-dates.js, which the team has marked as replaced by formatDate in lib/dates.js.

## Why it matters

The old date handling is still in use, so the team cannot remove it. Invoices go to customers, so a wrong date on an invoice is a wrong invoice.

## What fixed looks like

The invoice heading is written the same way as before, using the replacement the team named.

## For engineers

In src/invoice.js, replace legacyFormat with formatDate from ../lib/dates.js. The text it writes is the same, so the test in src/invoice.test.js keeps passing unchanged.

# Receipts still use the old date handling the team marked as replaced

src/receipt.js writes its date with legacyFormat from lib/legacy-dates.js, which the team has marked as replaced by formatDate in lib/dates.js.

## Why it matters

The old date handling is still in use, so the team cannot remove it. A receipt that shows the wrong day misleads the customer who paid.

## What fixed looks like

The receipt line names the day it was paid, written the same way as before, using the replacement the team named.

## For engineers

In src/receipt.js, replace legacyFormat with formatDate from ../lib/dates.js. The text it writes is the same, so the expected values in src/receipt.test.js stay as they are.

# The receipt test still uses the old date handling the team marked as replaced

src/receipt.test.js checks a date with legacyFormat from lib/legacy-dates.js, which the team has marked as replaced by formatDate in lib/dates.js.

## Why it matters

The test keeps the old date handling alive, so the team cannot remove it.

## What fixed looks like

The test checks the same date with the replacement the team named, and expects the same text.

## For engineers

In src/receipt.test.js, replace legacyFormat with formatDate from ../lib/dates.js in the one test that uses it. Keep every expected value the same.

json.rationale: Found three places that still use the old date handling.
